COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online without traditional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal is not just a necessity; it's a revolution in digital commerce. Many creators are locked out of mainstream platforms due to geographical restrictions, high fees, or stringent KYC processes. By leveraging cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments, musicians can accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, keeping more of their earnings. For instance, while Gumroad takes 10% of every sale, resulting in significant losses for creators, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This shift ensures that creators retain their revenue, empowering them to invest back into their music.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling music online and accepting Bitcoin is built on a combination of free and paid tools that work seamlessly together. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures that your store is fast and reliable. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle backend logic, processing orders and managing payments without relying on traditional payment processors. Supabase or Google Sheets can serve as your order storage, allowing for easy access and management. This stack not only provides robust performance but also guarantees that you own everything involved in your digital commerce operation, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. Musicians, ebook authors, and template designers in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela can leverage this sovereign stack to build their own digital storefronts. By utilizing cryptocurrency, they can bypass the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors, ensuring they receive payments directly and without unnecessary deductions. This solution empowers creators to take control of their commerce, enabling them to focus on their craft without worrying about payment barriers.
NOWPayments saves you significantly on transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this digital commerce stack include hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides a solid foundation for your music products. Backend logic can be managed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle tasks like order processing and payment confirmations. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as reliable order storage solutions. When combined with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you've got a comprehensive system that delivers your products instantly to customers while ensuring that you maintain full control and ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started selling music online and accepting Bitcoin, first choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Then, select an order storage method like Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing, allowing you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. Finally, configure your product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure your customers receive their purchases instantly. By following these steps, you can launch a fully operational online music store that keeps more of your earnings.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage platforms designed for digital commerce sovereignty. Use tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing payments in Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, ensuring you retain more of your revenue. This approach minimizes fees and maximizes your control over the sales process.
Your digital store is built on infrastructure you own, not one you rent.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook online by using platforms that support cryptocurrency payments. Utilize services like NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin directly, while hosting your content on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for low-cost, reliable access.

The most effective method is to create your own digital storefront using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup minimizes fees and maximizes your profit.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own digital store using free hosting and cryptocurrency payment solutions.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments offers numerous advantages, including a low fee of just 0.5%, support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, and no KYC requirements. This allows you to accept payments quickly and securely.
How does automatic product delivery work?
Automatic product delivery can be managed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle order confirmations and send products to customers instantly after payment is verified.
